title: Uniform sparse rationalisation of dyadic series
summary: Given any convergent dyadic series with nonnegative integer coefficients, any finite prefix and any eventually unbounded correction allowance, one common permitted set of upper Banach density zero supports nonnegative integer corrections realising every target in a nondegenerate interval above the original sum. Each fixed modulus eventually divides both corrections and cumulative corrections beyond a cutoff independent of the target.
